skills.detail:
After Griffon Rapid Strike is used, Skill 2 will transform into the Combo Skill Red-Haired Pursuit for a set period of time. Skill 2 turns back into Griffon Rapid Strike after Red-Haired Pursuit is used or after a certain amount of time passes.

Puts the character in Red-Haired Haki state. When in Red-Haired Haki state, the character gains Status Effect Nullification, can only be targeted by Normal Attacks, and cannot be Staggered. Plus, deals damage in a long-range area attack. Become temporarily invincible after use.
skills.name: Griffon Rapid Strike
